title: How AI-enabled software as medical devices are reshaping regulatory routes and medicine
summary: How AI-enabled software as medical devices are reshaping regulatory routes and medicine lauren.cummins Tue, 08/18/2026 - 08:56 Logo Thumbnail image In the news (media article) AI (Artificial Intelligence) Digital Disruption Medical Device & Diagnostics Regulatory Intelligence Technologies As AI-enabled software as medical devices become more prevalent, regulatory agencies are responding with new guidelines and AI-specific authorisation routes.
